events.description: Large group of civilians and police officers engaged in chaotic movement, pushing, and apparent clashes on a street; multiple individuals running, confronting, and engaging in physical contact amid police lines and vehicles with flashing lights.

At least two distinct pairs of individuals are seen in close physical combat: one pair near center-right (frame f9) with grappling and striking motions; another pair near left edge (frame f10) with one person lunging at another who is recoiling or being pushed back.

Large group of people, including uniformed police and civilians in dark clothing, engaged in dynamic movement across a street intersection; some individuals appear to be running or confronting each other, with visible tension and dispersal patterns consistent with a violent clash.

Two opposing groups face off on a city street; red and white smoke (likely from flares) is present, and a small fire/smoldering object burns on the road surface. Individuals are moving rapidly, some holding flags, indicating active confrontation between extremists and counter-protesters as described in the overlay text.

Large groups of people, including individuals in black clothing and others holding flares (red smoke and fire), are engaged in violent confrontation on a city street; police are present but not actively intervening in the immediate clash zone. Smoke and flares indicate use of pyrotechnics typical of riots.

At least two pairs of individuals are seen in close proximity with physical contact and aggressive postures (e.g., one person appears to strike or push another near center of frame at f4–f6); motion blur suggests rapid movement consistent with hand-to-hand combat amid the larger riot.

A large group of people are engaged in a violent clash on a street, with smoke (likely from flares or tear gas) filling the air and individuals moving aggressively; red flares are active on the ground, and participants appear to be confronting each other.

A large crowd is gathered in a street, with red flares ignited and smoke billowing; individuals hold signs (e.g., 'ASYLFLUT STOPPEN'), and police are present at the periphery—indicating collective violent unrest or confrontation.
Police in riot gear confront a crowd holding protest signs; visible tension and physical proximity suggest a volatile group confrontation, consistent with a riot or violent unrest.

Police in riot gear form a line facing a dense crowd holding protest signs; there is visible physical contact and pushing between police and protesters, indicating collective violent unrest or violent group clashes.

Large crowd of protesters confronts a line of police vehicles and officers; smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) is visible in the air, and police are deployed in formation with riot vans, indicating violent unrest or escalation beyond peaceful protest.

Crowd with German flags appears densely packed and animated; while no overt violence is visible in these frames, the context from prior frames and the presence of large banners and agitated movement suggest continuation of the unrest, possibly a different angle or phase of the same riot event.
